title: Benchmarking graph-based models for in-silico toxicity prediction in drug discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.37555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drug discovery is a costly and high-risk process, where toxicity-related failures remain a major cause of attrition in both preclinical and clinical stages. As a result, accurate early prediction of chemical toxicity is essential to reduce downstream costs and improve compound prioritization. In this context, graph deep learning (GDL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for toxicity prediction, leveraging molecular graph representations to learn directly from chemical structure with improved expressivity over traditional approaches.   Despite the growing number of proposed models, current literature-based comparisons are often difficult to interpret due to inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols. To address this limitation, we introduce a unified and standardized benchmarking framework for GDL-based toxicity prediction. translated_title: 面向药物发现中计算毒性预测的基于图模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 药物发现是一个成本高昂且高风险的过程，毒性相关失败仍然是临床前和临床阶段药物淘汰的主要原因。因此，准确地在早期预测化学毒性对于降低下游成本和改进化合物优先级排序至关重要。在此背景下，图深度学习（GDL）已成为毒性预测的强大范式，它利用分子图表示直接从化学结构中学习，相比传统方法具有更强的表达能力。尽管提出的模型数量不断增加，但由于数据集、预处理流程和评估协议的不一致，当前基于文献的模型比较往往难以解释。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了一个统一且标准化的基于GDL的毒性预测基准测试框架。我们在一致的条件下系统地评估了20多种代表性方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一且标准化的基准测试框架，在一致的条件下系统评估了20多种基于图深度学习的毒性预测模型，解决了以往文献比较中数据集、预处理流程和评估协议不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified and standardized benchmarking framework that systematically evaluates over 20 graph deep learning approaches for toxicity prediction under consistent conditions, addressing the inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols found in prior literature.
